public_claim: A BMX track guide last modified September 1, 1998 listed Desert Sky BMX in Glendale, Arizona in its National Bicycle League section, with track code 1103 and Tom and Sherri Lee as contacts.
evidence_character: FACT — CONTEMPORANEOUS PERIOD WEB DIRECTORY LISTING
evidence_boundary: This proves that the 1998 directory listed Desert Sky BMX in Glendale as an NBL track. It does not establish an exact street location, opening/closing dates, or later lineage.
admission_basis: Defensible attributed directory claim + inspectable period source + explicit boundary

public_claim: The same 1998 BMX track guide listed London Bridge BMX in Lake Havasu, Arizona in its American Bicycle Association section, with Frank Sabatano as the named contact.
evidence_character: FACT — CONTEMPORANEOUS PERIOD WEB DIRECTORY LISTING
evidence_boundary: This proves the period directory listing and city association. It does not prove that London Bridge BMX was the same track or organization as later Sara Park BMX Raceway or current Lake Havasu City BMX.
admission_basis: Defensible attributed directory claim + inspectable period source + explicit boundary

public_claim: A BMX track guide last modified in 1998 listed Parker BMX in Parker, Arizona in its ABA section; a separate regional BMX directory also listed Parker BMX in Parker.
evidence_boundary: The two directories independently support the Parker BMX name and Parker, Arizona association. Exact location, operating span and organizational history remain open.
admission_basis: Two inspectable directory families + bounded wording

public_claim: USA BMX's June 20, 2013 Olympic Day announcement listed Sara Park BMX Raceway in Lake Havasu City, Arizona for an Olympic Day race on June 27, 2013.
evidence_boundary: This proves the Sara Park BMX Raceway name, Lake Havasu City association and dated 2013 USA BMX event listing. It does not by itself establish the exact rename/continuity path to current Lake Havasu City BMX.
admission_basis: First-party dated event listing + explicit lineage boundary

public_claim: On June 16, 2003, the City of Tucson approved a lease with Desert Sunset BMX, Inc. for operation of a dirt bicycle track at the Harrison Landfill; USA BMX later listed Desert Sunset BMX in Tucson for Olympic Day on June 23, 2013.
evidence_character: RECONSTRUCTION — OFFICIAL MUNICIPAL RECORD + FIRST-PARTY BMX LISTING
evidence_boundary: These sources establish a 2003 Tucson lease for Desert Sunset BMX, Inc. at Harrison Landfill and a separate 2013 USA BMX track/event listing. They do not prove uninterrupted operation throughout the intervening decade or exact later lineage.
admission_basis: Two official source families + bounded synthesis

public_claim: A 2003 Redline Cup schedule listed Manzanita BMX Raceway in Tucson as a May 31 qualifier host, and an official sanctioning-body event record preserves race results from Manzanita BMX Raceway in Tucson on April 2, 2008.

evidence_boundary: The sources establish dated Manzanita BMX Raceway occurrences in Tucson in 2003 and 2008. They do not establish the track's full operating span, exact street location or relationship to current Tucson facilities.
